# Environment variables

Each process is configured by its environment, read once at start. A variable that is set but empty counts as not set. A value that cannot be used stops the process at start with a message naming the variable.

## The gateway (node)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `APG_CONFIG_SOURCE` | `file`, `api_poll` | `file` | Where the node reads configuration from. An unknown value fails startup. |
| `APG_CONFIG_FILE` | path | `/etc/apg/apg.yaml` | File or directory of apg.yaml documents. file source only. |
| `APG_NODE_ID` | string | required when source is api_poll | Stable, non-empty identity of this node. Defaults to the host name in file mode. |
| `APG_CONFIG_URL` | url | required when source is api_poll | Base URL of the config API. With the bundled admin this is <admin>/dp. |
| `APG_CONFIG_CLIENT_CERT` | path |  | Client certificate for mutual TLS to the config API. |
| `APG_CONFIG_CLIENT_KEY` | path |  | Key for APG_CONFIG_CLIENT_CERT. |
| `APG_CONFIG_CLIENT_CA` | path |  | CA bundle used to verify the config API. |
| `APG_ADMIN_URL` | url |  | Data-plane API of the bundled admin: snapshots, usage, heartbeats, certificate coordination. |
| `APG_NODE_TOKEN` | secret |  | Bearer token sent to the config API and the admin. |
| `APG_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` | integer | `1000` | Delay between polls when long polling is off, and the base of the failure backoff. |
| `APG_POLL_LIMIT` | integer | `500` | Rows per poll, at most 1000. |
| `APG_POLL_WAIT_MS` | integer | `25000` | Long-poll wait. 0 disables long polling. |
| `APG_LISTEN_HTTPS` | address | `0.0.0.0:8443` | Traffic listener (TLS). Empty disables it. |
| `APG_LISTEN_HTTP` | address | `0.0.0.0:8080` | ACME challenges, plus redirect or clear-text proxying per APG_HTTP_MODE. |
| `APG_LISTEN_MGMT` | address | `127.0.0.1:9100` | Health, readiness, metrics, status. Never exposed to clients. |
| `APG_HTTP_MODE` | `redirect`, `proxy` | `redirect` | What the HTTP listener does with non-ACME requests. |
| `APG_TRAFFIC_HEALTH_PATH` | string |  | A path the node answers itself on traffic listeners, for load balancers that cannot probe the management port. |
| `APG_DATA_DIR` | path | `/var/lib/apg` | Local config cache. One directory per node. |
| `APG_SECRET_KEY` | secret | required when the node handles certificates or $secret values in database mode | 32 random bytes, base64. |
| `APG_SECRET_KEY_FILE` | path |  | File holding APG_SECRET_KEY. |
| `APG_SECRET_KEY_PREVIOUS` | secret |  | Previous key, accepted for decryption during rotation. |
| `APG_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | cidr-list |  | Peers whose X-Forwarded-For is honoured. |
| `APG_REGION` | string |  | Reported in heartbeats and usage. |
| `APG_TLS_FALLBACK_CERT` | path |  | Certificate served when no Domain matches the SNI. |
| `APG_TLS_FALLBACK_KEY` | path |  | Key for APG_TLS_FALLBACK_CERT. |
| `APG_TLS_MIN_VERSION` | `"1.2"`, `"1.3"` | `1.2` | Minimum TLS version. |
| `APG_ACME_EMAIL` | string | required when any Domain uses tls.mode acme | ACME account contact. |
| `APG_ACME_DIRECTORY_URL` | url | `Let's Encrypt production` | ACME directory. |
| `APG_ACME_DNS_PROVIDER` | `cloudflare`, `route53`, `webhook` |  | Provider for dns01 challenges. |
| `APG_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` | secret |  | API token for the cloudflare DNS provider. It needs permission to edit DNS in the zone. |
| `APG_ACME_DNS_WEBHOOK_URL` | url |  | Endpoint for the webhook DNS provider. |
| `APG_ACME_DNS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | secret |  | Signs webhook DNS provider requests. |
| `APG_ACME_DNS_PROPAGATION_SECS` | integer | `30` | Wait between publishing a DNS challenge record and asking the authority to check it, 0 to 600. |
| `APG_USAGE_FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECS` | integer | `60` | Usage window length. |
| `APG_USAGE_BY_CONSUMER` | boolean | `false` | Add the consumer dimension to usage. |
| `APG_USAGE_SINK` | string | `none` | none or file:<path>. Used when no admin receives usage. |
| `APG_CACHE_MEMORY_BYTES` | integer | `268435456` | Memory budget of the response cache. |
| `APG_METRICS_MAX_SERIES` | integer | `10000` | Label sets kept before collapsing into route=_other. |
| `APG_LOG_LEVEL` | `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` | `info` | Log level. |
| `APG_LOG_FORMAT` | `json`, `text` | `json` | Log format. |
| `APG_LOG_REDACT_QUERY` | string-list | `apikey,token,access_token,signature` | Query parameters masked in access logs. |
| `APG_TEMPLATE_ENV_ALLOW` | string-list |  | Names templates may read as env.<NAME>. |
| `APG_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECS` | integer | `30` | Time in-flight requests get on SIGTERM. |
| `APG_DNS_REFRESH_SECS` | integer | `30` | How often backend host names are resolved again, 5 to 300. |
| `APG_BACKEND_ALLOW_CIDRS` | cidr-list |  | Private ranges an egress-restricted service may still reach; set it to the same value as on the admin. |

## The control plane (admin)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `APG_DATABASE_URL` | url | required when always | Postgres connection. |
| `APG_ADMIN_LISTEN` | address | `0.0.0.0:9000` | Admin API, UI and (unless APG_DP_LISTEN is set) the data-plane API. |
| `APG_DP_LISTEN` | address |  | Separate listener for /dp/*. |
| `APG_ADMIN_TLS_CERT` | path |  | Serve the Admin API over TLS. |
| `APG_ADMIN_TLS_KEY` | path |  | Key for APG_ADMIN_TLS_CERT. |
| `APG_SECRET_KEY` | secret | required when always | 32 random bytes, base64. |
| `APG_SECRET_KEY_FILE` | path |  | File holding APG_SECRET_KEY. |
| `APG_SECRET_KEY_PREVIOUS` | secret |  | Previous key, accepted for decryption during rotation. |
| `APG_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_TOKEN` | secret |  | First admin token. Generated and logged once when unset. |
| `APG_BOOTSTRAP_NODE_TOKEN` | secret |  | First node token. Generated and logged once when unset. |
| `APG_MIGRATE_ON_BOOT` | boolean | `true` | Run migrations at start. |
| `APG_ADMIN_JWT_JWKS_URL` | url |  | Delegated JWT authentication. |
| `APG_ADMIN_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY` | pem |  | Alternative to APG_ADMIN_JWT_JWKS_URL. |
| `APG_ADMIN_JWT_ISSUER` | string |  | Expected iss. |
| `APG_ADMIN_JWT_AUDIENCE` | string |  | Expected aud. |
| `APG_ADMIN_JWT_WORKSPACE_CLAIM` | string |  | Claim naming the workspace the caller is scoped to. |
| `APG_ADMIN_JWT_ROLE_CLAIM` | string |  | Claim naming the role. Default role: editor. |
| `APG_OIDC_ISSUER` | url |  | OpenID Connect login for the UI. |
| `APG_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | string |  | OIDC client id. |
| `APG_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | secret |  | OIDC client secret. |
| `APG_OIDC_ROLE_CLAIM` | string |  | Claim mapped to a role. |
| `APG_OIDC_ROLE_MAP` | json |  | Claim value to { role, workspaces }. |
| `APG_OIDC_SCOPES` | string | `openid profile email` | Scopes asked of the identity provider. |
| `APG_PUBLIC_URL` | url | required when OIDC is on | How browsers reach the admin; the identity provider sends them back here. |
| `APG_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION` | `none`, `dns_txt` | `none` | Whether a Domain must be proven before it becomes active. |
| `APG_CHANGELOG_RETENTION_HOURS` | integer | `168` | Age at which changelog rows are deleted. |
| `APG_NODE_SLOT_TTL_HOURS` | integer | `24` | Silence after which a node's replication slot is dropped. |
| `APG_USAGE_ROLLUP_INTERVAL_SECS` | integer | `60` | How often hourly and daily usage is rebuilt from the windows received. |
| `APG_USAGE_RAW_RETENTION_DAYS` | integer | `7` | Retention of raw usage windows. |
| `APG_USAGE_HOURLY_RETENTION_DAYS` | integer | `400` | Retention of hourly usage. |
| `APG_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | integer | `400` | Retention of the audit log. |
| `APG_EGRESS_ALLOW_CIDRS` | cidr-list |  | Private ranges non-admin callers may point callout URLs at. |
| `APG_BACKEND_ALLOW_CIDRS` | cidr-list |  | Private ranges non-admin callers may point backends at. |
| `APG_UI_ENABLED` | boolean | `true` | Serve the admin console. |
| `APG_UI_BRAND_NAME` | string | `valkv-apg` | Name shown in the console. |
| `APG_UI_LOGO_URL` | url |  | Logo shown in the console. |
| `APG_UI_PRIMARY_COLOR` | string |  | Accent colour of the console. |
| `APG_UI_EMBED_ORIGINS` | string-list |  | Origins allowed to frame the console. |
| `APG_UI_DIR` | path | `ui/ next to the service` | Directory holding the built console. |
| `APG_DEBUG_NODE_URL` | url |  | Management address of one node. It answers the route tester. |
| `APG_LOG_LEVEL` | `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` | `info` | Log level. |
| `APG_LOG_FORMAT` | `json`, `text` | `json` | Log format. |

## `apgctl`

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `APG_ADMIN_URL` | url |  | Admin API base URL. |
| `APG_ADMIN_TOKEN` | secret |  | Admin token. |
| `APG_CONTEXT` | string |  | Named context from ~/.config/apg/config.yaml. |
